resources.string: Open sites that block Iran (Gemini, AI tools, developer services) through a DNS provider that proxies them abroad, while Aether keeps opening filtered sites.
The device resolves names through the servers below instead of 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8. Sites the provider covers see the provider\'s country; everything else keeps the WARP exit.
Only applies to the Aether-only chain. With Psiphon or Tor in front, the exit is already abroad and this setting is ignored.
IPv4 addresses, separated by commas, spaces or new lines. Port 53 only (UDP). Up to 8 servers, tried in order.
None of these is a usable server (IPv4, port 53). The default resolvers will be used until one is.
Reach the Smart DNS servers straight from your connection instead of through WARP. Turn on only if your provider accepts registered or Iranian IPs only; the queries are then visible to your ISP.

Android\'s Private DNS (Settings, Network, Private DNS) must be Off or Automatic, otherwise the system ignores these servers. IPv6 is not offered to apps while Smart DNS is on. Check a site the provider covers, not an IP checker, to confirm it works.
